canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of the 925,356 FHA applications that lenders approved were not accepted by the applicant.

required_qualifiers.population: US FHA applications approved by the lender (originated + approved but not accepted; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)

does_not_establish: why an approved applicant did not proceed (pricing, a competing offer, a withdrawn purchase and reporting practice are not separable here)
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
